description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among all requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not set this parameter, **ClientToken** is set to the value of **RequestId**. The value of **RequestId** for each API request may be different.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

- **true**：发送检查请求，不会创建流量标记策略。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建流量标记策略。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

*   **true**: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
*   **false** (default): performs a dry run and sends the request.

description.zh:
为符合流分类规则的流量报文添加DSCP（Differentiated Services Code Point）值。取值范围：**0**~**63**。

一个转发路由器实例下，每个流量标记策略的DCSP值需保证唯一。
description.en:
The differentiated services code point (DSCP) value to be added to packets that match the traffic classification rule. Valid values: **0** to **63**.

The DSCP value of each traffic marking policy on a transit router must be unique.

description.zh:
流量标记策略的优先级。取值范围：**1**~**100**。

一个转发路由器实例下，每个流量标记策略的优先级需保证唯一。数字越小，优先级越高。
description.en:
The priority value of the traffic marking policy. Valid values: **1** to **100**.

The priority value of each traffic marking policy on a transit router must be unique. A smaller value specifies a higher priority.

description.zh:
流量标记策略的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the traffic marking policy.

This parameter is optional. If you enter a description, it must be 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://.

description.zh:
流量标记策略的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The name of the traffic marking policy.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://.

description.zh:
流量标记策略的流分类规则列表。

符合流分类规则的流量报文将被添加流量策略的DSCP值。

一次最多支持创建50个流分类规则。
description.en:
The traffic classification rules in the traffic marking policy.

Data packets that meet the traffic classification rule is assigned the DSCP value of quality of service (QoS) policy.

You can create up to 50 traffic classification rules.
The ID of the transit router.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn create-traffic-marking-policy --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-4260000 --dry-run false --transit-router-id tr-8vbuqeo5h5pu3m01d0000 --traffic-marking-policy-name nametest --traffic-marking-policy-description desctest --priority 5 --marking-dscp 5 --traffic-match-rules '[{"TrafficMatchRuleDescription":"desctest","MatchDscp":6,"DstPortRange":[80],"SrcCidr":"192.168.10.0/24","TrafficMatchRuleName":"nametest","Protocol":"HTTP","AddressFamily":"IPv4","SrcPortRange":[1],"DstCidr":"10.10.10.0/24"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --TrafficMatchRules.1.Protocol HTTP --TrafficMatchRules.1.AddressFamily IPv4 --Priority 5 --TrafficMatchRules.1.SrcCidr '192.168.10.0/24' --DryRun false --TrafficMarkingPolicyDescription desctest --TrafficMatchRules.1.SrcPortRange.1 1 --TrafficMarkingPolicyName nametest --MarkingDscp 5 --TrafficMatchRules.1.MatchDscp 6 --TrafficMatchRules.1.DstCidr '10.10.10.0/24' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-4260000' --TrafficMatchRules.1.DstPortRange.1 80 --TrafficMatchRules.1.TrafficMatchRuleName nametest --TrafficMatchRules.1.TrafficMatchRuleDescription desctest --TransitRouterId 'tr-8vbuqeo5h5pu3m01d0000'
